offer.step.request.title: You ask
offer.step.request.body: Sign in with your email and write what you need: in the portal, by email, or in the chat below. No call to get started.
offer.step.approve.title: I approve
offer.step.approve.body: I read every request myself. Nothing starts until I say so, and I tell you if it is the wrong thing to build.
offer.step.build.title: An agent builds
offer.step.build.body: An AI agent does the typing in a sealed copy of your project. It cannot publish, deploy, or touch anything live.
offer.step.ship.title: I check, then ship
offer.step.ship.body: I check the result before it goes anywhere. How closely is your call: a quick check that it runs, or every changed line. You follow it all in one thread.

pricing.attention.checked.for: New pages, forms, features, anything customers touch

offer.priceHook: A one-minute fix is {price}. No quote, no minimum.
offer.tagline: You vibe code most of it. I take the last mile — the bug, the deploy, the payments — billed by the second.
offer.priceNote: ${rate} an hour of my time, billed by the second; the AI at cost, no markup.
offer.priceRule: You pay for the time I actually spend, billed by the second, plus what the AI run cost, with no markup. No packages, no minimum.
offer.priceWhy: The less of me a job needs, the less it costs. A change the agent finishes on its own is a minute or two of my time. You choose how closely I look, and you can set a budget I will not pass without asking.
offer.serverless.title: Nothing to babysit
offer.serverless.body: What I build runs serverless. There is no server to patch or resize, and a traffic spike is not a migration project.
offer.who: For business owners who need software work done, not a development team to manage.
offer.why.yourself.answer: Do — most of it. When it stalls at the last mile, send me that part. A one-minute fix is {price} of my time, and you never wait for a quote.
offer.why.chatgpt.answer: It writes code. It does not put it in your project, run it, or answer for it. Here the agent does the typing and a developer approves the job before it starts and checks it before you see it.
offer.why.agency.answer: No quote, no call, no minimum invoice. A small fix does not wait until it is worth someone's afternoon: it is {price} of my time.
offer.why.cheapest.instead: the cheapest developer you can find
offer.why.cheapest.answer: On small jobs this is cheaper, because the agent does the hours and you pay for my minutes. And the person who signs off is the one you write to.
offer.safeguard.1: Nothing starts until I approve the request.
offer.safeguard.2: The agent works on a sealed copy of your project. It cannot publish, deploy, or touch anything live.
offer.safeguard.3: Set a budget and I will not pass it without asking.
offer.safeguard.4: If a machine stops mid-job, the job goes back in the queue instead of stalling.
offer.safeguard.5: Every message, change and decision is in one thread you can read.
